result.summary: Found 4 issues, mostly layout/content problems related to horizontal cropping and text truncation.

issues.description: 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card is cut off at the right edge of the screen, and its text label is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol')
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards are fully visible or add clearer scroll affordance so users know to swipe for more content

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off at the right edge, showing a partial hidden tab
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or scroll indicator to signal more categories are available

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you') has low contrast against the light green background, making it harder to read
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast between text and background color for better readability

issues.description: Bottom pizza promotion card is abruptly cropped at the bottom of the visible screen with no visible restaurant name or details
issues.suggestion: Ensure card content (name, rating, delivery time) is visible without requiring scroll, or maintain consistent card heights
